name: timbre-signer
description: Signs and notarizes Timbre builds with your Apple Developer ID, on this Mac. For the Timbre maintainer.
long_description: One tool, timbre_signing. It creates a private key and certificate request on this Mac (the key never leaves it), installs the Developer ID certificate into a dedicated keychain, keeps the App Store Connect API key for notarization in a private folder, then signs (hardened runtime), notarizes and repackages a Timbre .mcpb from Downloads.

tools.name: timbre_signing
tools.description: Set up Developer ID signing and notarization, then sign Timbre builds.
